title: 托福官方套题 05 · 口语

tasks.sample: We will talk about safety measures today.
First, you should always wear your goggles.
Second, to protect your clothing, please wear the lab coat that we provide.
A shower stall is in the corner in case of emergencies.
If it is needed, the fire extinguisher is near the door.
As required by our department, our first aid kit is well stocked and ready to use.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for participating. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about your shopping habits. First, can you tell me about a recent shopping experience and describe what you bought?
(Interviewer) I see. Shopping experiences can happen either in-person at physical stores or online from a phone or computer. Do you prefer shopping in physical stores or online? Why?

(Interviewer) As online shopping becomes more popular, there is more online advertising than ever before. Do you like online advertising or do you prefer ads in newspapers and magazines? Why or why not?

(Interviewer) Good points. Finally, looking to the future, some retailers are exploring the idea of using virtual reality for shopping, combining the convenience of online shopping with a simulated experience of shopping in a physical stores. Do you think that virtual reality shopping will be popular or unpopular? Explain your thoughts.
